statement: Use "Annotation Draw" in legacy Grease Pencil; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Remove or clear content in legacy Grease Pencil with "Delete Active Frame"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in legacy Grease Pencil with "Annotation Add New"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in legacy Grease Pencil with "Annotation Unlink"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in legacy Grease Pencil with "Add New Annotation Layer"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in legacy Grease Pencil with "Move Annotation Layer"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Remove or clear content in legacy Grease Pencil with "Remove Annotation Layer"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
